Open the [bulk remove-label prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=bulk&control=mode&state=reverse-label). Enter **Select bookmarks**, select the first two cards, open **Labels**, and choose **Remove label → Design**. Confirm that Design disappears from both cards and the selection clears.

I’ve assumed adding and removing labels share one bulk **Labels** control, with the direction stated explicitly before the change is applied.
